collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-20  -  THE TURTLE'S CROSSING SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: A turtle begins crossing a busy stretch of shore while villagers carry supplies toward the huts.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A turtle begins crossing a busy stretch of shore while villagers carry supplies toward the huts.

choices.label: Ask everyone to slow down and give it space.
Place a visible marker near the crossing.
Watch from a distance until the turtle moves on.
Ask an experienced villager whether intervention is necessary.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The turtle crosses safely, and the workers resume their journey.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The turtle stops for a long time, requiring the villagers to take another route.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The marker helps approaching villagers notice the turtle in time.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Wind knocks the marker aside, so a worker remains nearby to warn others.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The turtle eventually reaches quieter ground without interference.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The crossing takes longer than expected, and the observer misses part of the afternoon's work.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The villager recommends leaving the turtle undisturbed and redirecting foot traffic.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The villager notices a genuine obstruction and carefully clears the path ahead.
